name: Outlook (new)
description: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web: read the inbox, search, open, reply, forward, write and tidy email. Drafts only.
appVersionTested: New Outlook for Windows (olk.exe, WebView2) and Outlook on the web, September 2026
notes: New Outlook is the web app in a WebView2 window, so it shares names and shortcuts with Outlook on the web. Classic Outlook (OUTLOOK.EXE) has its own pack, outlook-classic, matched first by process. Accessible names are assumptions from earlier captures, not measured on this build.
